name: aiquants-platform-core
summary: Transport-agnostic platform contracts: business error codes (HTTP status times ten or a hundred plus a slot), the tenant header rule, Server-Sent Events framing, a bounded TTL cache, authenticated sealing of small secrets, an egress guard for outbound HTTP, and the neutral plugin base (descriptors, settings checks, conditions, contexts, ports and option batches).
author: fehde-k
